facts.fact: 老年 Isabel 每晚靠几杯葡萄酒与「上帝」对话，开始怀疑村民对丈夫的流言
facts.anchor: I found God in the several glasses of wine

facts.fact: 村民口中的 S— 庄园领主在公众想象中高大可怕，笼罩着日益危险的神秘斗篷
facts.anchor: He loomed large in the public imagination, large and scary.

facts.fact: 有人背地里称 Alexander 为巫师（Wizard），并讲了一则完整传说
facts.anchor: Wizard. One tale was told in full

facts.fact: 传说他在客栈诅咒乐手舞者跳到手指脚趾流血
facts.anchor: that they would play and dance until fingers and feet bled

facts.fact: 那一晚 Isabel 其实在场，但她的存在从传说中被完全抹去
facts.anchor: My presence had clearly been omitted from the tale, cleanly erased.

facts.fact: 他确实低声抱怨音乐业余、乐手像喝醉，但并未施咒
他死后人们传新的故事：绕他坟墓跳一百圈能把他召回复活
facts.anchor: After he died, they told another story

facts.fact: 老年 Isabel 透露 Mrs Hayworth 死后把全部遗产留给了她
facts.anchor: Mrs Hayworth was true to her word and left me all she owned
